description: Change a trigger that is switched off: page, entity, fields, message, number or flow. Only the fields given change. A trigger that is on is turned off first with disable_whatsapp_trigger.

app_id.description: The app the trigger belongs to.

entity_name.description: The entity whose new records fire it.

flow_id.description: Optional WhatsApp flow the conversation continues in.

message_template.description: The message; {{ field_name }} inserts a record field.

page_name.description: The page whose form creates the record.

phone_field.description: The record field holding the customer's WhatsApp number.

whatsapp_bot_id.description: The WhatsApp number that sends, from get_whatsapp_trigger_options.

name: update_whatsapp_trigger
title: Update Whatsapp Trigger
